page_title: CRE 1-3 ROM | Cremonese v AS Roma 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+3' 1 - 3 A perfectly taken corner kick. Francesco Folino (Cremonese) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the bottom left corner, increasing the score of today's match – 1:3.
90+3' A lofted cross from Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+2' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) is about to take a corner kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
87' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is replacing Matias Soule.
84' Yellow card! It's like Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Giovanni Ayroldi agrees and books him.
84' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
83' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
82' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) attempts to discuss the decision with Giovanni Ayroldi, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
81' Emil Audero leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma).
80' The substitution has been made. Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) has replaced Wesley Franca.
80' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Francesco Folino (Cremonese) replacing Matteo Bianchetti.
80' Substitution. Federico Bonazzoli walks off the pitch and Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) comes on as a substitute.
79' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
77' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Emil Audero (Cremonese) leaps to collect the ball.
76' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Wesley Franca (AS Roma). AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
74' Cremonese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

73' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Good work from Cremonese as they win a corner.
72' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) commits a foul and Giovanni Ayroldi immediately signals a free kick.
71' Manu Kone (AS Roma) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
70' Substitution. Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jari Vandeputte walks off.
69' 0 - 3 GOAL! Wesley Franca (AS Roma) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Emil Audero, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 0:3.
67' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
64' 0 - 2 Goal! Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Neil El Aynaoui, then sends the ball inside the right post. 0:2.
63' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
62' Gian Piero Gasperini is stunned as referee Giovanni Ayroldi shows him a RED CARD.
62' Although Gian Piero Gasperini (AS Roma) is just on the bench, Giovanni Ayroldi has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
61' A pass from Matias Soule (AS Roma) is intercepted by Emil Audero and the move breaks down.
60' Here comes a substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini is given a rest as he is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
60' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Matias Soule (AS Roma), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
59' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Tommaso Baldanzi will be replaced by Evan Ferguson (AS Roma).
58' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
57' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) replaces Romano Floriani.
57' It will be a substitution. Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) is ready to enter the pitch as Martin Payero walks off.
53' Giovanni Ayroldi blows the whistle, Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) is penalised for a foul.
52' Martin Payero (Cremonese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
49' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is out of play. Cremonese will have a throw-in.
46' Tullio Gritti makes a switch. Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) is coming on in place of Jan Ziolkowski at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Giovanni Ayroldi starts the second half.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+6' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+5' NO PENALTY! Referee Giovanni Ayroldi has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Cremonese players are incensed.
45+3' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Cremonese using VAR. Let's see what happens.
45+1' The players claim that Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. The referee points to the penalty spot. Cremonese are awarded a penalty kick!
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cremonese.
45' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
42' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

39' What a great touch by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot towards the roof of the net, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
39' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
36' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Matias Soule (AS Roma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
34' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' Martin Payero (Cremonese) is booked for saying more than Giovanni Ayroldi was willing to tolerate.
32' Matias Soule (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now AS Roma have a corner.
31' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) shoots the rebound towards the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows the goalkeeper to pull off a stunning save.
30' A tremendous drive by Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Mile Svilar makes a brilliant save.
29' Celebrations are cut short for AS Roma as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
28' Wait! Referee Giovanni Ayroldi has indicated he is going to review the AS Roma goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
27' Goal! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
26' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Emil Audero thwarts him with a nice save.
25' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
23' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Cremonese.
20' AS Roma hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

17' 0 - 1 Manu Kone passes to Matias Soule (AS Roma), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:1.
15' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Mile Svilar is alert and denies him.
14' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
13' Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul after Martin Payero (Cremonese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
12' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle as Warren Bondo (Cremonese) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
11' Martin Payero (Cremonese) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
10' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
9' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
5' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' The ball is cleared after Romano Floriani (Cremonese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
